items.title: NVIDIA Kumo: Foundation Models for Tabular Data (with Stanford Prof. Jure Leskovec)
items.summary: #NVIDIAKumo #TabularFoundationModels #GraphNeuralNetworks In Episode #1047, Jure Leskovec (Professor of Computer Science at Stanford and co-founder of Kumo AI, now part of NVIDIA) joins @JonKrohnLearns to explain how a foundation model that has never seen real data can beat hand-built models on enterprise tables. These models need no feature engineering and no training. Jure pioneered graph neural networks, and since NVIDIA acquired Kumo, his team has released the full Kumo family as open weights under a license that allows commercial use. In this episode, Jure breaks down the four Kumo models for tabular, relational, forecasting and anomaly-detection tasks, explains how they are pre-trained on synthetic data, describes how Biomni came to be used by more than 10,000 scientists within weeks and lays out why he believes human judgment has never been more valuable. items.title: HUGE: Jio Plans 1,600 Satellites to Take On Starlink
items.summary: Reliance Jio wants its own space internet: about 1,600 satellites, ideally launched on Indian rockets. Siddhanth and Ravi break down Jio's plan, the rocket problem in its way, and the race with Elon Musk's Starlink. According to a report in Mint, Jio Platforms is planning a low Earth orbit constellation of around 1,600 satellites, with a first test launch targeted around September 2027 and the full network by 2035. Jio is reportedly in talks with ISRO and Skyroot Aerospace, whose Vikram-1 became India's first private rocket to reach orbit this July. But Indian rockets can't yet launch that many satellites that fast, so Jio is also reportedly talking to SpaceX. items.title: The Data Science Lifecycle: From Feature Engineering to Model Scoring
items.summary: The model gets most of the attention. In practice it is often the smallest part of the work, and everything around it decides whether it delivers value. Terms covered: - Data Science Lifecycle: the end-to-end process, from defining the right problem through data preparation, modeling, validation, deployment, monitoring and maintenance - Feature Engineering: transforming raw data into what the model actually learns from. A timestamp becomes customer tenure. A transaction amount becomes a ratio against that customer's historical average. This work often shapes performance more than the choice of algorithm. - Model Scoring / Inference: the model making predictions on data it has never seen. Real-time fraud scoring, nightly batch demand forecasts, millions of recommendations at once. Understanding the full pipeline is what separates AI that works in a demo from AI that works in production. — AI Fundamentals Glossary | H2O.ai University Full playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAWKlIKS-66E Free courses and certifications: https://h2o.ai/university #DataScience #FeatureEngineering #MLOps #AIGlossary #H2Oai
